caption: The drawing is composed primarily in blue ink or watercolor on an off-white background. At the top center, there is text that reads “T.C. BOONE & SONS, SANDS ST. BROOKLYN.” Directly below the text, there are abstract shapes that resemble spectacles or glasses, two oval forms connected in the middle, and additional oval shapes underneath, all shaded in blue. These shapes are organized to suggest a face-like arrangement. In the bottom right corner, there is a simplified line drawing of a cylindrical milk can with two handles, also in blue. On the surface of the can are repeated the same textual inscription and abstract shapes seen above, positioned to mimic facial features. At the lower left of the rectangle framing the drawing, the name "GEO. LOUGHRIDGE" is inscribed. The background is otherwise plain and unmarked apart from minor shading around the primary drawings.
title: Jar
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
